title: Brain-derived neurotrophic factor and cytokines as predictors of cognitive impairment in adolescent and young adult cancer patients receiving chemotherapy
population_detail: AYAC aged 15-39 newly diagnosed; community-matched NC
cognitive_battery: CANTAB (multitasking, memory, response speed, executive function, attention) + FACT-Cog
extraction_notes: Table 3 reports only direction + p-values, no beta coefficients. Effect sizes back-calculated from p-values assuming df=55 (conservative Satterthwaite approx for LMM with n=66). Supplementary materials not available. From same ACTS cohort as Ng 2023 (10.1038/s41598-023-43581-1) — substantial participant overlap. BDNF→memory finding NOT re-extracted (already in Ng 2023 with actual beta+CI). Three novel cytokine→cognition findings extracted.
shared_cohort_note: Same ACTS study as Ng et al. 2023 (STUDY_NG_2023). AYAC sample overlaps substantially (Ng: n=74, Trudeau: n=66 chemo subset).
